static-hosting.limits: Initial-load JS 300 KB gzipped per file; lazy assets (workers, wasm, models) up to 25 MB each
static-hosting.note: Served at <app>.freeappstore.online over HTTPS from a public app repo; publishing runs fas check first.

offline-pwa.note: Required: every FAS app must be an installable PWA with a service worker that works offline.

auth.limits: GitHub, Google and email magic link; 30-day sessions
auth.note: Apple sign-in exists in the code but is not configured on the live platform (returns 503).

user-storage.limits: 1 MiB per user per app, 100 keys, 64 KiB per value
user-storage.note: Requires sign-in; private to the signed-in user within the app.

shared-data.limits: 10,000 documents per collection, 64 KiB each, 100 per query page
shared-data.note: Every document is publicly readable and only its creator can edit or delete it; queries filter only by owner or geo box and sort by created/updated time.

counters.limits: 1,000 counters per app; each increment -1,000 to +1,000
counters.note: Anyone can read; any signed-in user can increment, with no built-in one-vote-per-user check.

realtime.limits: 32 peers per room, 64 active rooms per app, 4 KiB messages, 100 msgs/sec per peer
realtime.note: Requires sign-in; messages are not stored.

file-storage.note: No upload API. Files can be kept in the browser (IndexedDB, file pickers); small data could go in KV or public collections (64 KiB cap).

email.limits: 100 emails/day per app, 50/day per sending user, 200-char subject, 50,000-char body
email.note: Sent from the browser by a signed-in user; comes from noreply@freeappstore.online with the subject prefixed [app-id]. No scheduled or server-triggered sends.

third-party-api-secret.limits: 5 secrets and 5 allowlist rules per app, 10,000 requests/day per app, 100 KB request and response
third-party-api-secret.note: Callers must be signed in. AI provider hosts (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Gemini) are refused. Responses are buffered, not streamed.

ai-user-key.limits: Key-vault proxy: 1,000 calls/day per user across apps, 100 KB request and response, no streaming
ai-user-key.note: User stores a key once (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google AI, OpenRouter, Replicate, Stability, ElevenLabs). The key is sent as a Bearer token. Apps can also call providers straight from the browser.

ai-platform.note: The platform provides no AI to apps, and the app-secret proxy refuses OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter and Gemini. Use the user key vault, a non-LLM AI API through the proxy, or an in-browser model.

server-compute.note: Apps are static; the platform API offers only its fixed services.

scheduled-jobs.note: Platform cron runs only platform tasks (uptime, backups, push reminders); app code never runs on a schedule.

payments.note: FAS apps take no payments: the host blocks the Payment Request API and fas check rejects checkout SDKs.

webhooks-out.note: Only friend events (requested, accepted, removed, blocked) and manual tests are actually sent. The other 8 listed events (kv, collection, counter, role, user) never fire.

custom-domain.note: Not self-serve: a platform admin wires each domain into the host and API config by hand (one exists today).

ads-free-tracking-free.note: fas check rejects analytics trackers (GA, Mixpanel, Segment, Amplitude, Hotjar, Plausible, PostHog) and payments; the host blocks the Topics API. No-ads is stated policy without an automated ad-SDK check.

browser-camera.note: Browser asks the user for permission.

browser-microphone.note: Browser asks the user for permission.

browser-geolocation.note: Only while the app is open; no background location.

browser-sensors.note: Motion and orientation work in all major mobile browsers; iPhone asks permission. Ambient light is Chromium-only.

browser-bluetooth-usb-serial.note: Allowed by the platform, but Web Bluetooth, USB and Serial work only in Chromium browsers (not Safari, Firefox or iPhone).

browser-screen-capture.note: Allowed by the platform; desktop browsers only (mobile browsers don't support screen capture).

browser-file-access.note: File pickers and downloads work everywhere; read/write File System Access (folders, save in place) is Chromium-only.

browser-wasm.limits: Lazy wasm/model files up to 25 MB each
browser-wasm.note: Threaded wasm/SharedArrayBuffer needs the per-app crossOriginIsolated opt-in (not on Safari).

browser-any-https-api.note: connect-src allows any https: and wss: origin; the API itself must allow cross-origin (CORS) requests.

push-reminders.limits: 10 devices and 20 reminders per user per app; sent on a 15-minute cycle
push-reminders.note: Only reminders the user schedules (once, daily, every N days) with fixed per-app text. No pushes triggered by events, other users or server checks. iPhone needs the app added to the Home Screen.

push-triggered.note: Nothing can send a push in response to an event, another user or a server check: only reminders the user schedules.

private-shared-data.note: Shared collections are publicly readable and only a document's creator can edit it, so data a family, team or business keeps private cannot be shared between its members.
